subject: constitution-prune remainder: the stash-B doc audit and the BATTLEPLAN tier-1 deferred items
activeForm: Working the documentation half of the constitution-prune campaign

Adjudicate the BATTLEPLAN tier-1 deferred items: the SECURITY.md lens, docs/diagrams/TEMPLATE.md, infrastructure/terraform/bootstrap/README.md, and whether injected-docs-check.sh becomes a hard gate

description:
TRIMMED 2026-09-22 after the first run landed as `card 8: attest` (596b07e8) and was attested card_after OPEN. The deploy-gate half is DONE and is not restated here; the spec that records it, with the regenerated census and the verification table, is specs/1401-deploy-gate-can-fail/spec.md. What follows is only what is left.

WHAT SHIPPED, so nobody re-derives it. All four advisory layers of the preprod deploy gate are closed and the gate can now fail. D2's four retry-helper defects were fixed in place, with a correction to the stowed record: stash-A was ALREADY APPLIED in the tree, so the broken helper was live rather than waiting in a patch. D3's force:true is dropped at dialog-dismissal.spec.ts and the test verified 8/8 without it.

REMAINING 1, THE DOC AUDIT. specs/stash-triage/stash-B-battleplanB-doc-audit.patch (331KB, 3 files) is measured NOT applying: all three hunks fail against CLEANUP-BOARD.html:68, docs/ci-gotchas.md:12 and docs/runbooks/terraform-state.md:9. It needs a rebase AND the fresh refuter pass this card has always required, because the docs it amends have changed. It was deliberately excluded from the first run: bundling a 331KB doc audit with a deploy-gate change makes both harder to review, and they share no files.

REMAINING 2, THE DEFERRED ITEMS from BATTLEPLAN-tier1-refute.md, unchanged and still open: the SECURITY.md lens (claimed controls versus actual controls, which is a different question from drift), docs/diagrams/TEMPLATE.md, infrastructure/terraform/bootstrap/README.md (rewritten 2026-08-01 and never refuted), and the policy call on whether injected-docs-check.sh becomes a hard gate in `make validate`, a non-gating CI annotation, or stays manual.

OPERATOR ACTIONS, not code and not fixable from this repository.
- TIINGO_API_KEY and FINNHUB_API_KEY still do not exist. `gh secret list` returns exactly CLAUDE_CODE_PAT, NEWSAPI_SECRET_ARN, PREPROD_JWT_SECRET and REPO_PAT, unchanged since 2026-08-01. Until they are created the 22 @external-api tests execute in zero CI contexts and nightly-e2e reports green having run nothing.
- NO WATCHING IS OWED. The 16 sanity tests have never once executed against preprod, so if preprod does not serve OHLC they now FAIL rather than skip and test-preprod goes red. That is the gate working. Rather than asking the operator to watch for it, the interpretation is written into AGENTS.md's gotchas: a red test-preprod is the gate working until proven otherwise, and the reported failure is diagnosed before the gate is reverted. Reverting restores a job that certifies every deploy green.

CARRY FORWARD, measured, so the trap is not re-entered: anchoring the accessible name does NOT disambiguate AAPL from AAPLW. The symbol and company spans (ticker-input.tsx:215-217) are adjacent with no whitespace text node, so Chromium computes the option name as 'AAPLApple Inc.' and /^AAPL\b/i matches ZERO options. Match rows by their own id="ticker-option-<symbol>" instead. A first pass used the name anchor and would have silently broken all 11 locators in sanity.spec.ts, the suite the gate runs and which has never executed, so nothing would have caught it.

CONTEXT WORTH KEEPING: deploy-prod is currently `if: false` (deploy.yml:1895, 'TEMP: Skip production'), as are build-sse-image-prod and build-dashboard-image-prod. The consequence chain the stow described is severed at the last hop, so the gate's lie reached preprod only. It restores itself the moment prod is re-enabled.
